reportMarkdown:
## ManualStream single lock, wake after unlock Finished

**Index:** 2 · **Checkpoint:** 5b1810a · **Result Commit:** bbd9bb9 · **Attempt Count:** 1

**Passed Status:** true. The profile shows the claimed mechanism (kernel mutex waits -58%), the MessagePack stream median rose 6% over 9 rounds, and nothing regressed. Unit tests (manual_stream, enumerable, stream filter), fmt, clippy, the wasm check and 8 native stream end-to-end cells pass.

**Scope lock:** only `src/completer/manual_stream.rs` changed; no out-of-scope changes.

**Finding:** the receiver thread is busy only about half the time in the stream workload, so server stream throughput on this machine is largely paced by the service sharing the machine. Both clients' stream rows swing by ±20% round to round (.NET MessagePack 0.95M–2.13M). End-to-end throughput gains from client-side CPU savings are therefore damped; per-operation client CPU cost would be a more sensitive measure.
